hook: *6 lakh litres* of treated factory water a day for ORR greenery
hook_b: *6 lakh litres* of treated factory water a day for ORR greenery
tldr: HMDA signed an MoU with Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages to reuse treated industrial wastewater for plantations along the ORR.

beats.what: HCCB's Avinya plant at Banda Thimmapur will supply 6 lakh litres of treated wastewater daily, mainly for ORR Exits 4 to 8.
beats.why: HMDA says it cuts groundwater use for green belts after recent El Niño conditions.
beats.care: Less freshwater and groundwater drawn for roadside plants as the city faces dry spells.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The water will also irrigate other green belts managed by HMDA.

cards.q: Should treated wastewater be used more for city greenery?

qs: How will the treated water's quality be checked?
How much groundwater did ORR plantations use before?

facts.t: Supply focuses on ORR between *Exits 4 and 8*.

steps.e: HCCB Avinya plant, Banda Thimmapur, Siddipet
ORR Exits 4-8 and HMDA green belts

watch: How the supply reaches ORR stretches and whether more industries sign similar MoUs.
